'''August 2001 Terryville tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG booster draft (non-sanctioned release party) held in Terryville, CT on 8 August 2001. [[John Mullarkey]] won it. It is known from John Mullarkey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2811">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-08-terryville-coruscant-party-8-8-01d2811/ terryville-coruscant-party-8-8-01], DeckTech (John "Scythykins" Mullarkey, 8 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-08-terryville-coruscant-party-8-8-01d2811/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Terryville, CT
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[John Mullarkey]]
